{"explanation": "This invoice from Conley Ltd (invoice 58478169, total 12261.98 USD, PO-ANATEST011) was held because the system could not read two fields with enough confidence: the invoice date (57% confidence, below the 90% threshold) and the currency (about 67%, also below 90%). Please open the original invoice document and confirm the invoice date (it was read as 2016-07-04) and that the currency is USD before matching it to the purchase order.", "email_subject": "Request to confirm invoice 58478169 details (PO-ANATEST011)", "email_body": "Dear Conley Ltd team,

Thank you for your invoice 58478169 referencing PO-ANATEST011 for a total of 12261.98 USD.

Our system could not clearly read the invoice date or the currency on the document. Could you please confirm the invoice date and the currency, or send a corrected copy of the invoice with these fields clearly displayed?

Once we receive this, we will review it further. Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
